component.name: Gnotes
component.summary: Markdown notes, on your computer or shared live

description.p: Write Markdown notes that read like formatted text. Start writing straight away with your notes kept on this computer, and move them to your own Gnotes server whenever you want them on your phone or to share them.

ul.li: Share a note or a whole notebook and edit it together live, with each other's cursors
Keep working offline; edits merge when you're back
Ask your notes questions, summarize and tidy them, with AI services you choose
Record voice memos with transcripts, and read the text in photos

description.p: The first release of the GNOME app.
